newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Samsung, Fokker talks next week - Dutch.
newsitem.headline: Samsung, Fokker talks next week - Dutch.

text.p: The Dutch government said on Thursday it was optimistic that talks between South Korea's Samsung Aerospace and Fokker, aimed at rescuing the stricken Dutch planemaker, could start next week.

"I'm a little more optimistic that talks (between Fokker and Samsung) can start, but that does not mean the result will be successful," Economic Affairs Minister Hans Wijers said in a brief statement.
